orgName: Maydan Tamweel Aloula (Al-Fateh Club Stadium, Al-Mubarraz)

source.name: AlFateh Saudi Club (@EnFatehclub) on X – stadium naming announcement
source.quote: announces the naming of its stadium as “Maydan Tamweel Aloula” under a three-year contract.
source.note: The club's English X account announced the naming on 25 September 2025. Deal value not disclosed. X pages need a browser; the post was read via the syndication endpoint.

note: Three-year naming-rights deal; the name is already in use (e.g. the Al-Fateh v Al-Hilal fixture page on alhilal.com gives the venue as Maydan Tamweel Aloula, Al-Hofuf).
